If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to avoid downward bias.  
If sentiment swings sharply (±0.33) in the last 3 days, apply a 2–3% downward correction to late horizon (16–30 days) to dampen momentum.  
When sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for early horizon to capture momentum.  
When sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast for mid horizon to avoid false rebounds.  
If sentiment is positive but price is declining, apply a 1–2% downward correction to late horizon to prevent overcorrection.
